The SVG path defines two elliptical arc commands with the same radii (23.43, 23.43), large-arc flags set to 1, and sweep flags set to 0, forming a closed shape.  
Since the radii are equal in both x and y (23.43, 23.43), the arcs are circular arcs, not elliptical.  
Two circular arcs with the same center and radius, connecting two points symmetrically with the large-arc flag set, form a circle.  

Final answer: (A)
